scope: Record production recovery after hosted Git builds failed to resolve relay dependencies stored in local sibling repositories.

failed_build.cause: The hosted Git build checks out GALXAI without its independent sibling repositories, while the relay source imported files from those local paths.
failed_build.impact: The previous Ready production deployment remained serving; no interruption was observed.

correction.resolution: The root manifest and lockfile pin immutable HTTPS archives; relay application source imports package entry points.
correction.local_docker: Dockerfile.relay-services keeps the local sibling source copies and explicit esbuild aliases.
correction.repository_boundary: BroccoliDB and BROCCOLIQUEUE remain independent repositories and are ignored by the GALXAI root repository.

production_deployment.build: Clean Git checkout at commit 63b54f8 installed both pinned packages, compiled successfully, passed type validation, generated 155 static pages, and completed in 3 minutes.

live_acceptance.cache: PASS: 38 live cache checks; private routes uncached and versioned assets immutable.
live_acceptance.public_http: PASS: preflight, protected diagnostics, public schema, rendered pages, and 38 browser assets.

limits: This release changed dependency resolution and local image bundling only; it did not alter product behavior or database schema.
No provider generation, Star activation, queue mutation, account-policy change, or Docker restart was performed.
